quote: “All the joy the world contains / Has come through wishing happiness for others. / All the misery the world contains / Has come through wanting pleasure for oneself.”
source: Shantideva, The Way of the Bodhisattva, chapter 8, verse 129 (trans. Padmakara Translation Group, rev. ed. 2006)
